title: Profile
desc: Everything here is optional. It stays in your own data and is never sent anywhere.

nameHint: We use it to greet you on the Recap page. It is only shown to you.
ageHint: So you can set goals such as “reach ₪200,000 by age 40”. We keep it up to date as the years pass.
genderHint: In Hebrew, words change for women and men. This lets the app speak to you correctly.
goalHint: Helps us decide what to point out first. Nothing changes without you.
